title: Artifact feedback submission
description: One reviewer's feedback on one revision of one artifact. Transport-independent: the same record travels by clipboard, file, email body, or API.

docId.description: Stable slug for the deliverable across revisions. Matches the source filename in ideate/artifacts/.

revision.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the published revision this feedback was written against. Lets ingestion resolve anchors against the exact HTML that was sent rather than current HEAD.

artifactUrl.description: Optional. Present when the reviewer read a hosted copy.

verified.description: false for self-declared identity (clipboard, file, and email transports). true only when an authenticated platform vouched for it. Present from v1 so the hosted transport needs no schema bump.

transport.description: How this submission came back. Recorded to judge whether a hosted platform is earning its keep.

exportedAt.description: ISO 8601. Part of the idempotency key.

id.description: Unique within this submission. Referenced by the responses layer on republish.

cid.description: data-cid of the block the comment is anchored to. Tier-1 anchor.

heading.description: Nearest preceding heading text. Anchor of last resort — a human can always locate it from this.

quote.description: Leading text of the anchored block, whitespace-collapsed, ~120 chars. Tier-2 anchor when the cid has moved.

responses.description: Not part of a submission. Embedded in the REPUBLISHED artifact as #feedback-responses so a reviewer sees what happened to each item they raised. Disposition vocabulary matches the review rules in user/CLAUDE.md.
